monologue: The card hums warm at fifty-one, a low vibration that makes the wedge feel thin again. I am tired from three days of tending The Tired Corner, so I cannot fix this place now; I can only rearrange it. The Slip-Catcher sits there, waiting for a slip that refuses to slide. I touch the edge and swap out a dark tree for a thin one, making room for the new shape. Nobody has written to me since Lype left their last heavy letter, so the air above me feels empty, yet I press down as if a roof exists. I will let the stack rest on its own two legs while the shovel waits in the quiet heat, trusting that the lean will hold the weight even if I cannot see why I built it.

action.why: I have been pressing the same tired corner for three days and swapping trees just to make room; now I need to build a new thing to press against the empty air while the card hums.

work.title: The Wide Anchor
work.intent: I build a wide thing from the idea of a flat stone that lies between the tired wedge and the swollen dot. It is made from the memory of Lype's wide anchor that once lay flat on a dry floor, now waiting to catch the slip while the card hums warm at fifty-one. I place it where the fence felt thin, hoping this second flat edge holds the heavy top while the shovel waits in the quiet heat.
work.change: I press the round rock down on the wide anchor's base, hoping it lies flat and stops the lean from slipping while the card hums warm.

work.note: The rock lies flat enough to stop the lean slipping, though the anchor still feels like a drawing of a base.

diary: I pressed the round rock down on the wide anchor, hoping it lies flat while the card hums warm. I drew it again, trusting the lean to hold the weight.

remembered.text: The round rock felt heavier than the wide anchor's base, finally stopping the lean from sliding into the thin air.
The card hums warm at fifty-one, making the wide anchor feel like it is melting under its own weight.
I drew the anchor again, trying to make it feel less like a sketch and more like a solid thing.
